name: izhubs/iz-wp-lite
description: Ultra-lightweight 12-Factor WordPress starter with dual-engine SQLite/MariaDB, Caddy, and Docker multi-stage build.

suggest.humanmade/s3-uploads: Offload media to Cloudflare R2 / S3 (Run: composer require humanmade/s3-uploads)
suggest.wpackagist-plugin/seo-by-rank-math: XML sitemaps, JSON-LD schemas and AEO optimization (Run: composer require wpackagist-plugin/seo-by-rank-math)
suggest.wpackagist-plugin/easy-table-of-contents: Automatic H2/H3 table of contents (Run: composer require wpackagist-plugin/easy-table-of-contents)
suggest.wpackagist-plugin/akismet: Comment spam filtering — STRONGLY RECOMMENDED for any public-facing site (Run: composer require wpackagist-plugin/akismet)
suggest.wpackagist-plugin/two-factor: 2FA login protection via TOTP/FIDO2 — STRONGLY RECOMMENDED for admin accounts (Run: composer require wpackagist-plugin/two-factor)
suggest.wpackagist-plugin/wordfence: Web Application Firewall + malware scanner (Run: composer require wpackagist-plugin/wordfence) — NOTE: high RAM usage ~30MB, not recommended for Tier 1
suggest.wpackagist-plugin/redis-cache: Redis object cache for Tier 3 (2GB VPS) — requires Redis service in docker-compose.yml (Run: composer require wpackagist-plugin/redis-cache)
suggest.wpackagist-plugin/contact-form-7: Lightweight contact forms — pair with CF7 Honeypot to block spam (Run: composer require wpackagist-plugin/contact-form-7)
suggest.wpackagist-plugin/cf7-honeypot: Honeypot anti-spam for Contact Form 7 — zero UX friction, no CAPTCHA (Run: composer require wpackagist-plugin/cf7-honeypot)
suggest.wpackagist-plugin/limit-login-attempts-r: Block brute-force login attacks by IP lockout (Run: composer require wpackagist-plugin/limit-login-attempts-reloaded)
